```{r}
library(rplum)
library(rbacon)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

coredir <- "Plum_runs"
thick_cm <- 1
sample_depths <- c(seq(0.5, 24.5, by = 1), 25.25)
curve_depths <- seq(0.25, 25, by = 0.25)

dat <- read_excel("TRET25_rplum_simple.xlsx", sheet = "input")

pb_input <- dat |>
  filter(Type == "Pb210") |>
  arrange(Bottom_depth_cm) |>
  transmute(labID = Sample, depth = Bottom_depth_cm,
            density = Density_est_g_cm3,
            Pb210 = Total_Pb210_Bq_kg, error = Total_Pb210_error,
            thickness = Thickness_cm,
            supported = Supported_Pb210_Bq_kg,
            supported_error = Supported_Pb210_error)

c14_input <- dat |>
  filter(Type == "C14") |>
  transmute(labID = Sample, age = C14_age_BP, error = C14_error,
            depth = Mid_depth_cm, cc = 1)

fallout_input <- dat |>
  filter(grepl("^Fallout", Type)) |>
  transmute(labID = Sample, age = C14_age_BP, error = C14_error,
            depth = Mid_depth_cm, cc = 0)

age_at <- function(d) {
  ages <- Bacon.Age.d(d, set = info, BCAD = FALSE)
  ages <- ages[is.finite(ages)]
  data.frame(depth_cm = d,
             median_cal_yr_BP = median(ages),
             lower95_cal_yr_BP = unname(quantile(ages, 0.025)),
             upper95_cal_yr_BP = unname(quantile(ages, 0.975)))
}
```

```{r}
# scenarios to test, dont hace to run all at once 
versions_to_run <- c("allpb_single_nomark", "allpb_single_mark",
                     "pb45_single_nomark", "pb45_single_mark",
                     "pb45_boundary_nomark", "pb45_hiatus_nomark",
                     "pb45_boundary_mark", "pb45_hiatus_mark")

break_cm <- 4.5
hiatus_max <- 100
anne_depth_cm <- 8.5
anne_age_BP <- 68
anne_error <- 10   # plotting assumption

specs <- data.frame(
  id = c("allpb_single_nomark", "allpb_single_mark",
         "pb45_single_nomark", "pb45_single_mark",
         "pb45_boundary_nomark", "pb45_hiatus_nomark",
         "pb45_boundary_mark", "pb45_hiatus_mark"),
  label = c("1: all Pb, no markers", "2: all Pb, markers",
            "3: Pb to 4.5, no markers", "4: Pb to 4.5, markers",
            "5a: boundary, no markers", "5b: hiatus, no markers",
            "6a: boundary, markers", "6b: hiatus, markers"),
  pb = c("all", "all", "cut", "cut", "cut", "cut", "cut", "cut"),
  structure = c("single", "single", "single", "single",
                "boundary", "hiatus", "boundary", "hiatus"),
  markers = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE),
  col = c("#CC79A7", "#CC79A7", "#0072B2", "#0072B2",
          "#009E73", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#D55E00")
)
specs$core <- paste0("TRET25_", specs$id, "_thick1")
```

## Run alternative models

```{r}
fit_version <- function(id) {
  sp <- specs[specs$id == id, ]
  core <- sp$core
  folder <- file.path(coredir, core)
  dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  pb_limit <- if (sp$pb == "cut") 4.5 else 10
  pb_i <- pb_input |> filter(depth <= pb_limit)
  dates_i <- c14_input
  if (sp$markers) dates_i <- bind_rows(dates_i, fallout_input)
  dates_i <- dates_i |> arrange(depth)

  dates_file <- paste0(core, "_C14.csv")
  write.csv(pb_i, file.path(folder, paste0(core, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(dates_i, file.path(folder, dates_file), row.names = FALSE)

  args <- list(core = core, coredir = coredir, otherdates = dates_file,
               date.sample = 2025, ra.case = 2, n.supp = 0, Bqkg = TRUE,
               cc1 = "IntCal20", BCAD = FALSE,
               thick = thick_cm,
               acc.mean = if (sp$structure == "single") 30 else c(20, 40),
               d.min = 0, d.max = 25.25, d.by = 0.5,
               remember = FALSE, ask = FALSE, suggest = FALSE,
               plot.pdf = FALSE)
  if (sp$structure == "boundary") args$boundary <- break_cm
  if (sp$structure == "hiatus") {
    args$hiatus.depths <- break_cm
    args$hiatus.max <- hiatus_max
  }

  pdf(NULL)
  do.call(Plum, args)
  dev.off()

  curve <- lapply(curve_depths, age_at) |> bind_rows()
  write.csv(curve, file.path(folder, "age_depth_curve.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  curve
}

curves <- lapply(versions_to_run, fit_version)
names(curves) <- versions_to_run
found <- specs |> filter(id %in% versions_to_run)
```

## Comparison plotting functions

```{r}
add_reference_points <- function(max_depth) {
  segments(fallout_input$age - fallout_input$error, fallout_input$depth,
           fallout_input$age + fallout_input$error, fallout_input$depth,
           col = "firebrick", lwd = 2)
  points(fallout_input$age, fallout_input$depth,
         pch = 19, col = "firebrick", cex = 1.2)
  if (anne_depth_cm <= max_depth) {
    segments(anne_age_BP - anne_error, anne_depth_cm,
             anne_age_BP + anne_error, anne_depth_cm,
             col = "black", lwd = 2)
    points(anne_age_BP, anne_depth_cm, pch = 18, cex = 1.8)
  }
}

plot_all <- function(max_depth, max_age, title) {
  plot(NA, xlim = c(-80, max_age), ylim = c(max_depth, 0),
       xlab = "cal yr BP", ylab = "depth (cm)", main = title)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(found))) {
    cv <- curves[[found$id[i]]] |> filter(depth_cm <= max_depth)
    lines(cv$median_cal_yr_BP, cv$depth_cm,
          col = found$col[i], lwd = 2,
          lty = if (found$markers[i]) 1 else 2)
  }
  abline(h = break_cm, lty = 3, col = "grey40")
  add_reference_points(max_depth)
  legend("topright", legend = c(found$label, "Fallout markers", "Anne charcoal peak"),
         col = c(found$col, "firebrick", "black"),
         lty = c(ifelse(found$markers, 1, 2), NA, NA),
         lwd = c(rep(2, nrow(found)), NA, NA),
         pch = c(rep(NA, nrow(found)), 19, 18),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
}

plot_one <- function(i, max_depth, max_age) {
  cv <- curves[[found$id[i]]] |> filter(depth_cm <= max_depth)
  plot(NA, xlim = c(-80, max_age), ylim = c(max_depth, 0),
       xlab = "cal yr BP", ylab = "depth (cm)",
       main = found$label[i], cex.main = 0.9)
  polygon(c(cv$lower95_cal_yr_BP, rev(cv$upper95_cal_yr_BP)),
          c(cv$depth_cm, rev(cv$depth_cm)),
          col = adjustcolor(found$col[i], alpha.f = 0.2), border = NA)
  lines(cv$median_cal_yr_BP, cv$depth_cm,
        col = found$col[i], lwd = 2,
        lty = if (found$markers[i]) 1 else 2)
  abline(h = break_cm, lty = 3, col = "grey40")
  add_reference_points(max_depth)
}
```

## Median age curves

```{r}
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 7.5
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot_all(25, 800, "Whole core")
plot_all(12, 300, "Top 12 cm")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Individual 95% credible intervals

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(found))) plot_one(i, 25.25, 900)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
